messages:
rana: FYI a customer on Dedicated reported an autofallback during staged rollout and then got an unexpected cost spike. Console shows only aggregate tokens + one model label. Need a proposal for per-variant billing and a clear UX for rollouts that switch models mid-request.

eli: Ugh. Do we currently attribute to the model that served the final tokens or the original route? We should avoid surprise invoices.

noor: Current emitter credits the model that produced tokens but the Console aggregates at route-level and labels the whole request with the route's primary model name. That mismatch is confusing.

rana: Example trace: trace=trace-77b, policy=auto-fallback:latency>200ms, rollout=canary-17. Request streamed 1200 tokens total, 800 from primary then switch to fallback for last 400. Billing showed 1200 @ primary rate.

mike: Proposal: emit per-inference 'inference_segment' events with fields {trace_id, segment_index, model_id, tokens, attribution_mode}. Minimal: POST /v1/telemetry/inference_segment -> {"trace_id":"trace-77b","segment_index":0,"model_id":"redwood-xl","tokens":800} then segment_index 1 for fallback.

noor: Add `attribution_mode` values: exact | estimated | mixed_kv. If mixed_kv, include estimated_share e.g. "estimated_share":"60/40".

eli: UX: in Billing > Routes show a compact stacked bar per-request with segments colored by model, and a hover tooltip listing tokens per-variant + unit price. For mixed attribution show a small "estimate" badge.

rana: Also need a clear label in Rollouts History: "autofallback -> redwood-small (latency)" plus a link to the audit playback. Customers asked for exportable evidence to contest invoices.

mike: Backend: index segments by trace_id, store per-segment token_count and model_id. Billing will sum per-account using the actual model rates at time-of-serve. We'll need a reconciliation API: GET /v1/billing/trace/{trace_id}/breakdown.

billing-bot: NOTE: billing policy requires final invoice to be reconcilable. If Console shows estimates, include a reconcile button that triggers an official breakdown report (signed).

noor: Security/compliance: evidence/exact logs might contain PII. For exports we must obey redaction policy per-account. Add a signed-report endpoint that applies redaction and returns CSV/JSON.

eli: Edge: prefix replay and KV cache might attribute tokens to the original host even though fallback produced output. Need `cache_origin_span` on segments so UI can explain which tokens were from cache vs recomputed.

rana: UX nit: show "served_by" microcopy: primary model name (with strike-through) -> fallback model name, and a small "why" pill (reason + metric value).

mike: I'll add telemetry proto + indexer. Quick sketch for event: {"event":"inference_segment","trace_id":"trace-77b","segment_index":1,"model_id":"redwood-small","tokens":400,"attribution_mode":"exact","cache_origin_span":null,"fallback_reason":"latency>200ms"}

noor: Console changes: (1) per-request stacked breakdown, (2) export button, (3) playback link to Rollouts, (4) estimate badge. I'll mock.

ops-bot: Deploy: canary rollout of `segment-attribution` service started 2026-06-10T09:12Z.

rana: Owners: mike (telemetry/indexer), noor (console UX), eli (billing reconciliation), rana (product + runbook). I'll open ticket and ping legal for export redaction rules.

billing-bot: ALERT: create monthly alert if autofallback-driven model-shifts >15% of billed tokens for an account. Recommend auto-notify account owner and SE.

rana: Great. Let's keep the playback + billing reconciliation scope small for the first sprint. PRs please reference ticket RF-1123.
